title: Hector’s Tres Leches

items: 1 pint of Half & Half milk (Any FoodTown or Tuscan brand), you can find this at the grocery store next to the fresh milk

steps: Add the egg whites and beat (with a hand mixer) until they form a meringue.
add the cup of sugar little by little, continue beating
add the egg yolks one by one
lower the mixer speed and add the cup of flour
Pour the mixture into a mold, level it, and place it in the oven at 350-315 degrees for about 30 minutes.
Using a fork, break the entire cake into small pieces.
mix the three milks (evaporated milk, condensed milk and Half & Half)
Put the cake in the refrigerator for 1 hour
spread the cool whip all over the cake
Put it in the refrigerator to cool.
reviewFlags: The source gives the oven temperature as 350–315 degrees. Confirm the intended setting before baking.
headnote: The source gives the oven temperature as 350–315 degrees. Confirm the intended setting before baking.
sourceNote: *If you can't get Presto flour, there's another type of flour from Swam or another that already contains Baking Powder (which makes the cakes rise).
